newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star says mild weather helped Q1.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star says mild weather helped Q1.

text.p: Lone Star Industries said Tuesday the substantial improvement in its first quarter results was primarily due to mild weather that enabled contractors to start projects earlier than expected.

Lone Star reported first quarter earnings of $0.02 a share, versus a loss of $0.29 a share a year ago. The construction materials company said it normally records a loss in the first quarter because demand for its construction products slows during the winter months.
It said first quarter sales volume of its cement operations rose about seven percent from a year earlier, to $49.4 million from $42.9 million.
Lone Star said its gross profits in cement operations improved to $11 million from $5.9 million a year ago, and average net realized selling prices were seven percent higher.

The company said that while there is a risk of flooding on the Mississippi River later this spring, which could impact its Cape Girardeau, Mo., and New Orleans operations, it continues to believe 1997 will be a good year.
